title: The q^5 square law selects one leading analytic tangent in the symmetric two-radius chart

selection.jacobian: J=det d(kappa_6,x)/d(p,a)=97048.7740746550... is nonzero at the isolated K1727 seed
selection.uniqueness: The nonzero Jacobian makes these two affine first-order conditions uniquely solvable. Every other quartic-optimal tangent has xi!=0 and pays the strict q^5 excess xi^2/5040.
selection.second_order_boundary: beta=0 imposes one affine condition on the two second-order chart coefficients. The remaining second-order freedom and all higher coefficients require later orders; K1738 selects only the leading tangent.

scope_guard: Uniqueness is for the first chart velocity among regular quartic-optimal paths. It does not imply unique second-order continuation, remote-branch exclusion or an all-seed optimizer.
